title: Peter’s miraculous rescue
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Acts 12:3-17: Herod arrests Peter, the church prays earnestly, an angel wakes Peter, his chains fall off, the iron gate opens by itself, Peter goes to Mary's house, Rhoda is so glad she forgets to open the gate; lessons: God answers prayer, have faith.

floor.prerequisite: Knows Peter and John stood firm.
floor.question: By whose name was the lame man healed?

representations: a sequence strip of six boxes
steps: An angel frees him; chains fall off.
Peter goes to Mary's house; Rhoda forgets the gate.
contexts: a family praying for a relative in hospital
trusting God in a hard place

board.do: Draw a prison and a house full of people praying.

board.say: What were the people in the house doing?

board.do: Wait for the child to say praying for Peter.
Draw the path from the prison to the house.

misconceptions.ask: How did Peter get out of prison?
What was the church doing while Peter was in prison?
What did Rhoda do when she heard Peter's voice?
Where did Peter go after the angel left him (Acts 12:12)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Acts 12:12 and draw the house full of praying people. Peter went where they were praying for him.

checks.question: How did Peter get out of prison?
checks.answer: An angel woke him and the chains fell off

checks.question: What did Rhoda do when she heard Peter?
checks.answer: Ran in with joy without opening the gate
